scenarios.name: Close a saved inactive document with its tab close button

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` and `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd` are open in that order
the second part is saved and has no unsaved changes
the user clicks the close button on the second part's document tab
the first part remains active in the workspace
